source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Configuration" -> Click "SNMP"
Check SNMP information when it is enabled.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: SNMP v1/v3 function should be normal and information should be displayed correctly.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: net-snmp + a 2nd host; BMC SNMP agent configured by operator
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP Trap verifies the BMC SNMP agent/trap functionality; it needs a management/trap-receiver host and enabling/configuring SNMP on the BMC Web UI (community/v3 + trap destination). Agent can from the trap receiver run `snmpget -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" system.sysDescr.0 2>&1` to sanity-check the agent after it is configured by the operator.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpget/walk output confirming the BMC SNMP agent responds for the SNMP Trap mode; the trap destination/receiver setup + Web UI enable is the operator part.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: enabling SNMP + pointing traps is a config change on the BMC; needs a 2nd host as trap receiver and read-only community.

original_test_intent: Validate BMC SNMP trap configuration and delivery for the required SNMP modes.
original_method: Engineer inspects/enables SNMP in BMC WebUI; source provides no trap receiver, stimulus or packet-level acceptance.
manual_activity: After correction, engineer configures/observes BMC WebUI; agent can run the receiver, trigger an approved event if automatable and correlate packets/logs.
required_inputs: Approved trap stimulus and expected enterprise OID/varbinds
safety_requirements: Do not expose community strings, SNMPv3 keys or send traps to an unapproved host.
Use an isolated receiver and read-only account where applicable.
Do not invent a hardware fault; use an approved safe stimulus.
Restore configuration and never retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, capture receiver traffic, correlate stimulus timestamp/OID/varbinds and compare expected delivery.
Do not claim WebUI operation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Define trap contract and configure/restore WebUI.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: SNMPv2c GET proves neither a v1/v3 trap nor asynchronous receiver delivery and conflicts with source modes.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an approved v1/v3 trap receiver and deterministic safe event, with packet and BMC-event correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: WebUI path, v1/v3 criterion and 5/0-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define each protocol/security profile, configure one controlled receiver, generate one safe event and verify exact trap identity, payload, latency and cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC with documented trap MIB and security support.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor SNMP trap and MIB documentation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Tests trap functionality rather than agent query reachability.

project_override_considerations: Project may disable v1 for policy and test only approved modes, but must report that reduced matrix explicitly.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title says Trap, while Procedure only displays SNMP information and DeepSeek proposes a v2c GET; Criteria name v1/v3 without delivery semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Without a trap stimulus and expected receiver payload, success cannot be observed or distinguished from an ordinary query.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects GET as a trap substitute.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Block is semantic, not caused by missing package or WebUI attendance.

review_improvement: Defines asynchronous trap evidence and security cleanup.
independent_technical_reasoning: A responding SNMP agent may never emit traps. The event, destination and expected payload are essential test semantics; absent them, automation would test the wrong function.
